(09b) the graph as normal, the bottom row `config: 1 problem · ? shows them` (muted).
(09e) the last row is the pane's own keys — `space stage`, `d discard`, `⌃A all`, `e edit`, `⇥` — and `? keys`; no `c commit`, no `. actions`, no `/ search`.
(09e) the last row reads `⏎ open  j/k move  u undo  ? keys` — no `/ search`.

(10) three whole frames: at startup the status row `config: 1 problem · ? shows them`; the `.` menu on the branch row with `Merge feature into main (M)`; the menu closed, the bar reads `M merge` and no `M map` anywhere.

(11) `?` on the graph: a box at most 96 wide centred over the graph, titled `keys here`, `esc close` on its top border, the `›` query row, then `HERE` (the graph's keys, `▸` on the first) and `EVERYWHERE`; the bar reads `↑↓ move  ⏎ run  esc close`.
(11) `⌃P` on the graph: the same box titled `find anything`, one `ACTIONS` group, each row `key  label … config id`.

(11) the start screen behind, a box titled `keys here` with `esc close` on its top border, the `›` query row, `HERE` (open, init, …, `▸` on the first) then `EVERYWHERE`; the bottom row `↑↓ move  ⏎ run  esc close`.
(11b) at 80×24 the bar ending `? keys`, then the same screen with `?` open, `HERE` first.
(11b, J7) the rebase stopped and resolved, `?` open — `IN PROGRESS` the first group, `▸c Continue` under the cursor, then `HERE` and `EVERYWHERE`.
(11d) `. explain` leads, `u undo` is drawn, and `? keys` is not — it ranks right after `u undo` and `/ search` and is drawn, last, only once both fit; `?` still answers.
(11e) the cursor on an evil merge that is the branch tip, marked by the radar, the pane shut: at 140 columns, past the 137 a marked branch tip needs, the bar ends `? keys`.
(11d) the bar reads `⏎ that commit  ^ before it  L history of these lines  ? keys  /  space  w  esc` — `? keys` after the words, leading the bare keys.
(11e) the journal's footer ends `J/esc close  ? keys` — the doorway last, after the journal's own keys.
(11e) the Map's footer reads its keys, then `? keys`, then ` · +3 more · partial`.
(11e) the stash footer reads `⏎ apply  p pop  s save  d drop  b branch  space files  S/esc close  ? keys` — `b branch` between drop and files, the doorway last.
(11e) the stash list at 60 columns: the footer sheds whole clauses from the middle and keeps `? keys` last — never a cut word.
(11d) `?` over the Map: HERE lists the Map's own keys; EVERYWHERE the Global keys that act here; no `c commit`, `R`, `m merge`, `/ Find…`.
(12) typed `rebase` in `find anything`: ACTIONS, then BRANCHES, FILES (directory muted), COMMITS (sha muted), COMMANDS RUN RECENTLY, in that order.
(12) the empty palette: the field reads, muted, `type to find actions, branches, tags, files, commits`; COMMANDS RUN RECENTLY under it.

(13, J20) frame 1, `u` with the cursor one row below the merge — `▸` on `HEAD`'s row (`[◆ feature]`), the merge gone, the status `undo: merge … ✓`. Frame 2, `j` then `U` — `▸` back on the redone merge, the top row.

(13) `f` then `q` before the fetch answers — a box `Quit?` reading `fetch all remotes is still running · quit stops it`, `[ Cancel ] [ Quit ]` with the cursor on Cancel, the bottom row led by `y quit`.

(13b, J24) frame 1, `m m` then `q` — a box `Quit?` reading `merge … is still running · quit waits for it to finish` / `if it stops at a conflict or fails, you stay to see it`; frame 2, after `y`: no box, the status row `merge … · quitting when it finishes · esc stays`.

(13b, J25) frame 1, after `q y` and the (injected) offer — the status row `merge … · still running after 10 s · q stop it now · esc stays`, no box; frame 2, after `q`: a box `Quit now?`, `[ Cancel ] [ Quit ]` with the cursor on Cancel, the bottom row led by `y quit`.
(13b) a merge stopped at a conflict, the banner focused: the bottom row is the stop's words, then `⏎ resolve  c finish  a abort  M mergetool e edit  ⇥ graph  q quit`, `q quit` last.
(13b) the same at 80×24: `q quit` is the one key gone, so `merge stopped` still fits before the other six.

(13c–13d) the one shell line after the stop box's `y` stopped a merge stuck in its hook — `trib: stopped merge main into feature after 10 s · the merge is paused · trib here offers continue or abort`; below, the next launch: `MERGING` on top, `UNCOMMITTED · 2 staged` with the merge's result alone.

(13g) the terminal closed mid-merge: nothing printed; the next launch shows the stash `[stash@{0}] … your edits, set aside for merge main into feature`, the banner `merge still in progress from a previous run · edits aside · c finish  a abort`, and `UNCOMMITTED · 2 staged`, no unstaged section.

(14d) `R`, then `d` on part 2: the editor's AFTER column names each fork — `feature-c` stays (following would lose part 2), `feature-b` follows.

(15) the cursor on `HEAD`'s row, its bar holding both `a amend` and `u undo` at 100 columns.
